paper_title: Measuring (a Sufficient) World Model in LLMs A Variance Decomposition   Framework
caption: : Meaningful Variability Share

annotations.annotation: The bar chart represents the proportions of two components, labeled as "MVS" and "1-MVS," across four categories: Health and Nutrition, Logistics, Personal Finance, and Travel and Transportation. Each category contains two stacked bars corresponding to "70B llama" and "8B llama." The horizontal axis contains these categories and is labeled with each subcategory in tilted text. The vertical axis displays the values ranging linearly from 0.0 to 1.0, with a tick interval of 0.2. The green portion of each bar signifies the "MVS" component, while the blue portion indicates "1-MVS," as shown in the legend situated at the bottom center of the plot. Both components sum up to a value of 1.0 in each bar. In Health and Nutrition, in the bar for "70B llama" green portion is dominant, and "8B llama" shows a larger portion of blue compared to green. Similarly, in Logistics and Travel and Transportation, both bars exhibit an approximately equal distribution of blue and green components. In Personal Finance, the distribution is not equivalent, with more green in the "70B llama" bar with more blue in the "8B llama" bar. Finally, in Travel and Transportation, both "70B llama" and "8B llama" bars have an equal portion of blue portion with blue being the dominant one, and are not sorted by size but are grouped by category and subcategory, and there is no visual emphasis on any individual bar.
